verdict.rationale: Martin is a SaaS AI assistant, a kind of product that could plausibly offer team or organization admin controls, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only individual-user integrations and capabilities (calendar, inbox, Slack, to-dos, notes, briefings). Nothing covers organization workspaces, member management, role permissions, or admin-set data policies. Community privacy concerns are general skepticism, not evidence of admin controls.
